description: This file contains benchmark functions for evaluating various matrix multiplication (sgemm) kernels, particularly tailored for operations used in neural network architectures like MobileNet, ShuffleNet, ResNet, SqueezeNet, and VGG. It sets up performance tests with different configurations, cache considerations, and scales, using the Google Benchmark framework.
